what: Explanation of how to integrate sv-memory as an MCP server, skill, hook, or rules within antigravity-cli, and project-scoping options.
why: The user asked for indications on how to integrate sv-memory or hooks in antigravity-cli and whether they need to be in the project root.
learned: To integrate sv-memory in antigravity-cli, it can be configured globally (in ~/.gemini/config/) or locally (in .agents/ at the project root) using mcp_config.json, hooks.json, skills, and rules (GEMINI.md/AGENTS.md). Being inside the project is only required for project-specific configurations.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
